title: Read the samples and the waits

blocks.content: To read how the query behaves over time, complete the following steps. If a tab is empty, skip it and go on.

blocks.title: Read the samples and the waits

blocks.content:
Open the **Query samples** tab.

Record whether the points sit together, or whether a few sit far above the rest. A few long runs can be an occasional slow run, certain parameter values, or one stretch of time. The average on the query's row does not show that spread.

Open the **Wait events** tab.

The categories are **IO wait**, **Lock wait**, and **Network wait**. Record the named wait event that contributes the most time, such as `Lock:relation` or `IO:DataFileRead`. The change is based on that named wait event.
You have a record of the sample spread and of the wait event that takes the most time.
